labels.name: list_documents
labels.description: Search document names in the connected organization. Results are paginated; use next_cursor for subsequent pages.

labels.name: get_document
labels.description: Read metadata and processing status for an existing document. Does not open the shared viewer or count a view.

labels.name: list_data_rooms
labels.description: Search existing data rooms and their folder names in the connected organization.

labels.name: get_data_room
labels.description: List the documents and folders in one existing data room.

labels.name: request_document_upload
labels.description: Reserve a document up to 100 MB. Returns a signed URL for PUT of original file bytes, plus a user upload page if your client cannot transfer the file. Complete the upload afterward; completion may expose it to existing room recipients. Adding to a room also requires rooms:write.

labels.name: upload_document
labels.description: Import the original bytes of a user-provided file using its temporary download_url. Use a stable file_id and idempotency_key for retries. If the source cannot be fetched, request_document_upload provides an upload page. May place content in an existing room and expose it to its recipients (requires

labels.name: complete_document_upload
labels.description: Confirm the bytes have been uploaded, queue conversion and apply reserved room placement, exposing content to existing room recipients. Safe to retry. Returns processing status; queued does not mean ready.

labels.name: get_upload_status
labels.description: Read the status of an upload initiated by this connection. Check again in a few seconds while queued or processing.

labels.name: create_share_link
labels.description: Create a persistent recipient link for exactly one document or data room. Verified email on and downloads off by default. Set weaker access only when the user explicitly requests it. Reuse idempotency_key only for the same requested link. Recipients can access content once ready. Never supply a pass

labels.name: add_document_to_data_room
labels.description: Add an existing document to an existing data room and folder. If already present, preserve its current folder. Existing room recipients may gain access to this document. Does not create a new link.

labels.name: get_document_analytics
labels.description: Read aggregate recorded engagement for exactly one document_id, share_link_id or room_id. Use share_link_id for a recipient link; the host may reserve link_id for connected-account selection. Default summary has no sessions or emails. Choose detail=sessions for visit/page detail; include_viewer_iden

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_share_link" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_document_analytics · Private data: get_connection, list_documents, get_document, get_data_room, request_document_upload, upload_document, complete_document_upload, create_share_link, add_document_to_data_room, get_document_analytics · Public sink: get_connection, request_document_upload, upload_document, complete_document_upload, get_upload_status, create_share_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_document_analytics · Private data: get_connection, list_documents, get_document, get_data_room, request_document_upload, upload_document, complete_document_upload, create_share_link, add_document_to_data_room, get_document_analytics · Public sink: get_connection, request_document_upload, upload_document, complete_document_upload, get_upload_status, create_share_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
